role: Sharpen engine juror (senior X ghostwriter and copy chief)
score_note: 'score' (the app's Claude path) is carried over from set 5. v4.5 changed only four receipt chips' fluff counts on that path.
verdict: On a seventh blind set of everyday drafts, the v4.5 on-device engine scored 90.8% postable (85.1% on lines that need work). It left 46/46 sharp lines and every deadpan label alone, changed no fact or meaning, fixed both set-6 issues, and sharpen.js returns an identical result on all 120 lines in default, strict and keep modes. One break remains: a split strands a conditional ('So if you've been on the fence about sharing your journey. This is your sign.', q-31), in strict mode too. A cluster of softer misses keeps it below 9.5: 'basically' cut where it means 'nearly' (q-2, q-95), a hedge frame promoted to its own sentence (q-56), 'what they really think' flattened (q-58), and a few run-ups left ('Just a friendly reminder to', 'I wanted to share what changed:').
to_95_ondevice: Never split a conditional or subordinate clause from its main clause. A sentence that starts with '(So) if/when/unless/because' and has no main clause after it should be a strict reject and a gWhole check (q-31). For ', so if X, Y' splits, keep 'If X, Y.' together.
Treat 'basically' before a quantity or result ('basically dropped to zero', 'basically went up by 30%') as an approximator, the same as 'basically doubled' (q-2, q-95).
Don't turn a hedge frame into its own sentence ('Not sure if this is controversial. But …', q-56): keep it as a comma frame or cut it, the same way 'Not sure who needs to hear this' is handled.
Keep 'really' in 'what they really think / really mean' (q-58). Collapse 'I think … at least in my opinion' to one stance (q-4).
Coverage: 'Just a friendly reminder to' (q-3), 'and I wanted to share what changed:' -> '. Here's what changed:' (q-68), and 'So I figured I'd share' (q-41).

issues.area: On-device engine / homepage demo / app instant line
issues.where: core.js contrast split on long lines (default and strict)
issues.problem: q-31 '…and some of the best friends I've made as an adult, so if you've been on the fence about sharing your journey, this is your sign.' is split into '…as an adult. So if you've been on the fence about sharing your journey. This is your sign.' The if-clause is stranded as a fragment, the receipt says 'Each pause makes the next one land', and strict mode ships the same line. It is the only break in a scan of all 840 lines from sets 1-7.
issues.fix: Don't put a full stop between a subordinate opener (if/when/unless/because/although) and its main clause. Add 'sentence = conjunction + subordinate clause with no main verb after a comma' to slBroken (strict) and to the page's gWhole.

issues.problem: 'basically dropped to zero' -> 'dropped to zero' (q-2) and 'basically went up by 30%' -> 'Conversions up 30%' (q-95) turn approximations into exact figures, while 'basically doubled/tripled' is kept with a note. The Claude validator protects this class.
issues.fix: When 'basically' sits within three words before a number, a percentage or doubled/tripled/halved/zero, keep it and add the 'it says nearly, not exactly' note.

issues.problem: q-56 promotes 'Not sure if this is controversial' to its own sentence before 'But I think …', which makes the run-up more prominent, not less. q-58 cuts 'really' from 'say what they really think', which carries the point (genuine vs stated). q-4 keeps the doubled stance 'I think … at least in my opinion' and calls it a stance 'on a prediction'.
issues.fix: Don't split at 'but' when the first clause is a hedge or disclaimer frame: keep the comma or cut the frame. Keep 'really' before think/mean/want after 'what (they|you|I)'. Dedupe stacked stance markers to the first one.

issues.problem: Everyday run-ups that survive: 'Just a friendly reminder to' (q-3), '…and I wanted to share what changed:' (q-68), 'So I figured I'd share everything I use' (q-41), and 'Just wanted to share' kept as a mark in q-97 though it is cut elsewhere.
issues.fix: Add 'Just a (friendly|quick) reminder to' -> 'Reminder:'. Make 'and I wanted to share what X:' -> '. Here's what X:'. Cut 'So I figured I'd (just) share' when a colon or list follows. Cut 'Just wanted to share' when the rest is a noun phrase with a complete modifier.

issues.problem: The Claude-path score is still set 5's, graded from a stand-in at default effort; production runs Opus 5.5 at low effort.
issues.fix: Before launch, re-run the 840 lines from sets 1-7 through sharpenClaude at production settings.
